## Purpose and Targets
Pearcleaner is a native macOS 13+ Swift/SwiftUI utility for uninstalling apps and associated files, plus file search, Homebrew/package management, app updates, architecture/translation cleanup, and monitoring Trash for removals. The Xcode project builds three executables: the main app, Finder extension, and Sentinel background agent: `Pearcleaner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`, `Pearcleaner/PearcleanerApp.swift`, `FinderOpen/FinderOpen.swift`.

## Application Composition and Entry Points
`Pearcleaner/PearcleanerApp.swift` starts the SwiftUI application and routes into the main window/UI shell at `Pearcleaner/Views/MainWindow.swift`. Shared application state, commands, environment setup, and user-initiated automation are concentrated in `Pearcleaner/Logic/AppState.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Logic/AppCommands.swift`, and `Pearcleaner/Logic/DeepLink.swift`. The command-line surface is implemented separately in `Pearcleaner/Logic/CLI.swift`.

## Uninstall and File-Discovery Pipeline
The core cleanup flow identifies installed apps, extracts app metadata and candidate paths, searches for related files, lets users select results, then performs removal with history/undo support. The main stages are:
- application enumeration and metadata: `Pearcleaner/Logic/AppPathsFetch.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Logic/AppInfoFetch.swift`;
- path matching/search models and execution: `Pearcleaner/Logic/FileSearch/FileSearchLogic.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Logic/FileSearch/FileSearchModels.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Logic/ReversePathsFetch.swift`;
- files-selection presentation: `Pearcleaner/Views/FilesView/FilesView.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Views/FilesView/FileListView.swift`;
- destructive action recovery/history: `Pearcleaner/Logic/UndoManager.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Logic/UndoHistoryManager.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Views/DeleteHistoryView.swift`.

This boundary requires Full Disk Access for searching and uses elevated operations for protected system locations.

## Privilege, Permissions, and Background Integration
Privileged filesystem work is delegated from the app through helper-management logic to a dedicated helper executable, rather than being performed entirely in the UI process: `Pearcleaner/Logic/HelperToolManager.swift`, `PearcleanerHelper/main.swift`, `PearcleanerHelper/com.alienator88.Pearcleaner.PearcleanerHelper.plist`. Code-signature validation is explicitly present at `PearcleanerHelper/CodesignCheck.swift`. Permission visibility/querying is modeled separately through macOS TCC support: `Pearcleaner/Logic/TCC/TCCQueryHelper.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Views/Components/TCCPermissionViewer.swift`.

The Sentinel agent observes filesystem activity—principally apps sent to Trash—and enables automatic cleanup: `PearcleanerSentinel/main.swift`, `PearcleanerSentinel/FileWatcher.swift`, `PearcleanerSentinel/com.alienator88.PearcleanerSentinel.plist`.

## Package, Homebrew, and Update Subsystems
Homebrew is a first-class external command/package-management integration, with controllers for package/tap lifecycle, uninstallation, and scheduled updates: `Pearcleaner/Logic/Brew/HomebrewController.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Logic/Brew/HomebrewManager.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Logic/Brew/HomebrewAutoUpdateManager.swift`. Installer package inspection uses bridged macOS package/private APIs: `Pearcleaner/Logic/PKG/PKGManager.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Logic/PKG/Pearcleaner-Bridging-Header.h`.

Application updating is coordinated by a queue/manager layer supporting App Store, Homebrew, Sparkle, and iOS-app paths: `Pearcleaner/Logic/AppsUpdater/UpdateManager.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Logic/AppsUpdater/UpdateQueue.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Logic/AppsUpdater/SparkleUpdateDriver.swift`. App Store update operations include private CommerceKit and StoreFoundation framework declarations under `Pearcleaner/Logic/AppsUpdater/PrivateFrameworks`.

## User-Facing Feature Boundaries
The UI is organized by feature domains rather than a web/service architecture. App browsing begins in `Pearcleaner/Views/AppsView/AppsListView.swift`; update orchestration is surfaced in `Pearcleaner/Views/AppsUpdaterView/AppsUpdaterView.swift`; Homebrew administration lives in `Pearcleaner/Views/Brew/HomebrewView.swift`. Specialized operational views cover file search, binary thinning, and orphan/zombie cleanup: `Pearcleaner/Views/FileSearchView.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Views/LipoView/LipoView.swift`, `Pearcleaner/Views/ZombieView/ZombieView.swift`.

## Persistence, Resources, and System Dependencies
The app uses app-group defaults for cross-target shared state: `Shared/AppGroupDefaults.swift`. It relies on macOS filesystem APIs, TCC permissions, launchd-style plist agents/helpers, code signing, Homebrew, App Store internals, and Sparkle-based app update mechanisms. Entitlements define the security boundary for main and Finder targets: `Pearcleaner/Resources/Pearcleaner.entitlements`, `FinderOpen/FinderOpen.entitlements`. Localized strings and bundled assets reside under `Pearcleaner/Resources/Localizable.xcstrings` and `Pearcleaner/Resources/Assets.xcassets`.
